The '''Obroa-skai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Atlas" /> that contained at least four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the gas giant [[Obroa-held]].<ref name="Destiny" /> The library world of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] was the fourth world in the system.<ref name="Agents" />
